description: Set the visual identity the whole video follows. Every field is optional; call it again to change only some fields. If the user shares a logo, a brand guide or their website colours, read the colours from it and fill them in. Bundled fonts: Bricolage Grotesque (sans-serif), Caveat (handwritten), DM Sans (sans-serif), DM Serif Display (serif), Fraunces (serif), Inter (sans-serif), Lora (serif), Montserrat (sans-serif), Nunito (sans-serif), Playfair Display (serif), Poppins (sans-serif), Space Grotesk (sans-serif). Or pass a font file path (woff2, woff, ttf, otf). Colours: bg = page background, surface/surface2 = shapes and panels, card = cards and bubbles, accent/accentDeep = highlights, ink = titles, text = body text, muted = small text.

bodyFont.description: Bundled font name or path to a font file.

captionStyle.description: pill = rounded bubble, bar = accent band, plain = bold text only.

headingFont.description: Bundled font name or path to a font file.

logo.description: Path to the logo image (PNG with transparency or SVG works best). Use "" to remove it.

logoPlacement.description: Corner tag in every scene (logo, or series name if there is no logo).

outro.description: Added to the closing card: @handle, website, call to action.

seriesName.description: Name shown on title cards and in the corner tag, e.g. a series or brand name.

name: set_brand
